title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 小猫钓鱼
page_text_en: Little Cat Fishing
summary_zh: 本页是绘本的标题页，画面中一只小猫正在河边钓鱼，钓起了一条大金鱼，背景是绿树、草地和蓝天。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 有一天，猫姐姐和猫小弟扛着鱼竿、提着小水桶去河边钓鱼
page_text_en: One day, Cat Sister and Cat Brother carried fishing rods and brought small buckets to go fishing by the river.
summary_zh: 画面中，猫姐姐和猫小弟扛着鱼竿、提着小水桶，一起去河边钓鱼，背景是绿草如茵、鲜花盛开的山坡和远处的山峦。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 他俩坐在河边，挂好了鱼饵，准备好好地钓上几条大鱼
page_text_en: They sat by the river, put on the bait, and got ready to catch a few big fish.
summary_zh: 猫姐姐和猫小弟坐在河边，挂好鱼饵，准备钓鱼。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 不一会儿，一只花蝴蝶飞了过来
page_text_en: After a while, a colorful butterfly flew over.
summary_zh: 画面中，一只花蝴蝶飞过绿草如茵的山坡，背景是青山、彩虹和蓝天，暗示着宁静美好的自然环境。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 花蝴蝶真美丽，猫小弟看到了好喜欢呀
page_text_en: The flower butterfly is so beautiful, Little Cat Brother is so happy to see it!
summary_zh: 猫小弟在河边钓鱼时，看到一只美丽的花蝴蝶，非常喜爱。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 他连忙放下鱼竿，去追逐花蝴蝶，想把蝴蝶捉住
page_text_en: He quickly put down his fishing rod, ran after the flower butterfly, and wanted to catch it.
summary_zh: 猫小弟放下鱼竿，追逐一只花蝴蝶，想要捉住它。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 可是花蝴蝶很快就飞走了，猫小弟什么也没捉到
page_text_en: But the flower butterfly flew away quickly, and Little Cat caught nothing.
summary_zh: 猫小弟追逐花蝴蝶，但蝴蝶飞走了，他什么也没捉到。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 他空着手，情绪低落的回到了河边
page_text_en: He returned to the riverside empty-handed, feeling downcast.
summary_zh: 猫小弟空手而归，情绪低落地回到了河边。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 这时，专心钓鱼的猫姐姐钓到了一条好大的鱼
page_text_en: At this moment, the focused Cat Sister caught a big fish.
summary_zh: 猫姐姐专心钓鱼，成功钓起了一条闪闪发光的大红鱼，显得非常开心。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 猫小弟羡慕地看着姐姐，心想：我要是能钓到一条这么大的鱼就好了
page_text_en: Little Cat looked at his sister enviously, thinking: If only I could catch a fish this big.
summary_zh: 猫小弟看到姐姐钓到大鱼后感到羡慕，心里想着自己也能钓到这么大的鱼就好了。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 过了一会儿，有一只蜻蜓飞了过来
page_text_en: After a while, a dragonfly flew over.
summary_zh: 画面中，一只粉色的蜻蜓飞过绿草如茵的山坡，背景是青山、彩虹和蓝天，暗示着宁静美好的自然环境。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 猫小弟又连忙放下鱼竿，去追捉蜻蜓
page_text_en: Little Cat hurriedly put down his fishing rod and went to catch the dragonfly.
summary_zh: 猫小弟放下鱼竿，追逐一只飞过的粉色蜻蜓。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 蜻蜓也很快地飞走了
page_text_en: The dragonfly also flew away quickly.
summary_zh: 猫小弟追逐粉色蜻蜓，但蜻蜓飞走了，他空手而归，画面中他表情略显失落。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 猫小弟什么也没捉到，闷闷不乐，空着手回到了河边
page_text_en: Little Cat caught nothing, feeling unhappy, and returned to the riverbank with empty hands.
summary_zh: 猫小弟追逐蜻蜓失败，空手而归，闷闷不乐地回到河边。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 这时，专心钓鱼的猫姐姐又钓到了一条大鱼
page_text_en: At this moment, the focused Cat Sister caught another big fish.
summary_zh: 猫姐姐专心钓鱼，成功钓起一条闪闪发光的大红鱼，显得非常开心。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 猫小弟又坐下来钓鱼，可他总坐不住，东瞧瞧，西看看。过了好久也没钓上鱼
page_text_en: Little Cat sat down to fish again, but he couldn't stay still, looking here and there. After a long time, he still hadn't caught any fish.
summary_zh: 猫小弟再次尝试钓鱼，但心不在焉，四处张望，结果过了很久也没钓到鱼。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 猫姐姐对他说：钓鱼就是钓鱼，三心二意可不行，你一会儿追蝴蝶，一会儿捉蜻蜓，怎么能钓到鱼呢？
page_text_en: Cat Sister said to him: Fishing is fishing, you can't be distracted. You chase butterflies one moment, catch dragonflies the next—how can you catch any fish?
summary_zh: 猫姐姐对猫小弟说，钓鱼要专心，不能三心二意地追蝴蝶或捉蜻蜓，否则钓不到鱼。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 猫小弟听完姐姐的一番话，惭愧地低下了头
page_text_en: After hearing his sister's words, Little Cat lowered his head in shame.
summary_zh: 猫小弟听完姐姐的劝告后，感到惭愧，低下了头。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 这次猫小弟坐下来，认认真真地钓起了鱼
page_text_en: This time, Little Cat sat down and fished with full concentration.
summary_zh: 猫小弟在姐姐的劝告后，放下心事，认真地坐下来钓鱼，画面中他和姐姐并排坐在河边，专注地等待鱼上钩。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 过了一会儿，蝴蝶又飞了过来，猫小弟就像没看见一样
page_text_en: After a while, the butterfly flew over again, but Cat Little Brother acted as if he didn't see it.
summary_zh: 蝴蝶再次飞到猫小弟面前，但他这次没有像之前那样分心，而是专心钓鱼，仿佛没看见蝴蝶一样。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 又过了一会儿，蜻蜓也飞了过来，猫小弟理也没理，一步也没离开
page_text_en: After a while, a dragonfly also flew over, but Cat Little Brother didn't even pay attention and didn't move an inch.
summary_zh: 蜻蜓飞到猫小弟面前，但他这次专心钓鱼，没有分心，一直坐在河边不动。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 突然，猫小弟觉得鱼钩一沉，他使劲往上一拉
page_text_en: Suddenly, Little Cat felt the fishing hook sink, and he pulled hard upward.
summary_zh: 猫小弟在专心钓鱼时，突然感到鱼钩下沉，于是用力向上拉，似乎有鱼上钩了。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 原来是一条好大好大的鱼
page_text_en: It turned out to be a really big, really big fish.
summary_zh: 猫小弟用力拉起鱼竿，钓上了一条闪闪发光的大红鱼，画面聚焦于这条鱼，表现出钓鱼成功的喜悦。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 猫小弟赶紧捉住了这条大鱼
page_text_en: Little Cat quickly caught the big fish.
summary_zh: 猫小弟成功钓到一条大红鱼，他赶紧捉住鱼，脸上露出惊喜的表情。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 他喊出了声：我钓到大鱼啦！我钓到大鱼啦！
page_text_en: He shouted: I caught a big fish! I caught a big fish!
summary_zh: 猫小弟成功钓到一条大红鱼，兴奋地大声欢呼，脸上满是惊喜和喜悦。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 猫姐姐和猫小弟坐在河边又钓到了很多鱼
page_text_en: Cat Sister and Cat Little Brother sat by the river and caught many fish again.
summary_zh: 猫姐姐和猫小弟并排坐在河边钓鱼，各自的桶里都装满了钓到的鱼，画面展现了他们钓鱼成功的喜悦。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 天快黑了，姐弟俩每人提着满满的一水桶鱼，高高兴兴地回家了
page_text_en: It was getting dark. The brother and sister each carried a full bucket of fish, happily heading home.
summary_zh: 天快黑了，猫姐姐和猫小弟每人提着装满鱼的水桶，高高兴兴地走在回家的路上。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 走在路上，猫小弟对姐姐说：我知道了，只有一心一意才能钓到大鱼
page_text_en: Walking on the road, Little Cat said to his sister: I understand now, only by being fully focused can I catch a big fish.
summary_zh: 猫小弟和姐姐走在回家的路上，猫小弟向姐姐分享自己学到的道理：只有专心致志才能钓到大鱼。

title_en: Little Cat Fishing - With Background Music
page_text_ocr_zh: 小猫钓鱼
page_text_en: Little Cat Fishing
summary_zh: 本页是绘本《小猫钓鱼》的标题页，画面中猫姐姐和猫小弟手持鱼竿，站在绿草如茵、鲜花盛开的田野上，背景是青山和蓝天，营造出愉快的户外钓鱼氛围。
